recognize_zh: 背景是密集的顆粒球系增生（含嗜酸性、嗜鹼性球），中央有一顆小型、核只分兩葉的低分葉巨核細胞（dwarf/hypolobated megakaryocyte），這是 CML 骨髓的典型線索。
features: Small hypolobated megakaryocyte with a bilobed nucleus and finely granular pink-gray cytoplasm (dwarf megakaryocyte)
Marked granulocytic hyperplasia with myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Scattered eosinophils and basophils with coarse dark granules
Occasional larger immature myeloid cells; blasts not obviously increased
Adjacent cell with multilobated overlapping nucleus, possibly a second megakaryocytic cell or overlap artifact
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular with marked granulocytic hyperplasia showing maturation, accompanied by increased eosinophils and basophils. A small megakaryocyte with a hypolobated, bilobed nucleus and moderate granular cytoplasm is present, typical of the dwarf megakaryocytes seen in CML. Blasts are not obviously increased in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, chronic phase.

ddx.vs: MDS micromegakaryocytes accompany multilineage dysplasia and cytopenias, without the marked granulocytic hyperplasia and basophilia of CML.
ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei, not small and hypolobated, and granulopoiesis is not expanded.
PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei in tight clusters and the disease is BCR::ABL1-negative.

ddx.dx: 5q- syndrome (MDS with low blasts and isolated del(5q))
ddx.vs: Del(5q) MDS has monolobated rather than bilobed megakaryocytes, macrocytic anemia and no granulocytic hyperplasia.
